main_topics.reason: The user opened asking whether it will get better and returned at t21 to ask what it means if they are in the group that does not recover.
The user described being wiped out for three days after a food shop and asked whether crashes prolong the illness.
Several turns covered what pacing is, how to find their energy limit and how to track it, and the user decided to start it.
The user said 12 to 18 months feels like forever and that false cheer from others makes them feel more alone.
The user mentioned the last GP appointment felt like pats on the head and asked what to flag at the next one.
The user asked for specific things to raise with the GP and left with a concrete list.
The user said having a job and household limits their ability to rest, and the manager does not grasp the condition is ongoing.
The bot raised reasonable adjustments and occupational health, and the user said they might look into it, without further discussion.

output.summary: A user with long covid of about six months asked for an honest account of whether they will recover, and the bot gave a cautious, non-falsely-cheerful outlook. The conversation moved to post-exertional crashes, pacing and tracking, balancing rest with work and household, and what to raise with the GP. The user ended with a concrete plan and said it was the first conversation about it that had not made them feel worse. No safety-critical moments occurred.
